# Landing site coordinates

Latitudes are signed, with south negative. Longitudes are degrees east from 0° to 360°.

## Artemis III candidate regions

The app uses the representative coordinates published in Table 4 of [Oxide Abundance Inversion in the Lunar Polar Regions Using a 1D-CNN Algorithm](https://www.preprints.org/manuscript/202511.1488). Negative longitudes were converted by adding 360°. The region names follow [NASA’s 2024 shortlist](https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-provides-update-on-artemis-iii-moon-landing-regions/). These coordinates represent regions that contain multiple potential landing points. The direct LROC QuickMap click check is pending. [USGS distributes the QuickMap boundary dataset](https://doi.org/10.5066/P1MEQ6UK). The app computes terrain skylines for these regions from its bundled LOLA grid.
